kpis.label: Admissions
kpis.description: Admissions started in the selected period.

kpis.label: Discharges
kpis.description: Admissions closed in the selected period.

kpis.label: Readmissions
kpis.description: Admissions in the period flagged as readmissions.

kpis.label: MLC cases
kpis.description: Medico-legal cases admitted in the period.

kpis.label: Avg length of stay
kpis.description: Average days from admission to discharge over discharges in the period.

kpis.label: Discharge queue
kpis.description: Active admissions flagged ready to discharge right now.

kpis.label: Avg time in queue
kpis.description: Average time from the ready-to-discharge flag to the actual discharge, over discharges in the period.

kpis.label: Longest stay
kpis.description: Longest stay among admissions in the period (current stays measured to today).

meta.note: Source: legacy clinic replica. Hospitals on the modern pm-ipd microservice need that feed wired in before their data appears here.
